records.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — Imported feed HTML is stored using `raw_html`, bypassing sanitization in `Post#cook` and allowing scripts and event handlers to survive as stored XSS on the forum’s origin; sanitize imported HTML before storing or rendering it.

records.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:63–64 — Protocol-relative URLs such as `//cdn.example.com/image.jpg` are incorrectly treated as paths on the article host, breaking resources; resolve references against the article URL.
records.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue in the `absolutize_urls` method at lines 56-72 of topic_embed.rb. The code only handles URLs that `start_with?('/')` (absolute paths), but does not handle protocol-relative URLs (starting with '//') or document-relative URLs (not starting with '/'). For protocol-relative URLs like '//example.com/image.jpg', the code would incorrectly prepend the prefix since '//' starts with '/'.
